description: Create a new wiki page in a course with a title and optional HTML body, published state and editing_roles, and return the created page — including its url slug, used as page_url by get_page, update_page and delete_page. Not idempotent: each call creates another page; Canvas does not deduplicate by title, so check list_pages first to avoid creating a duplicate. Use update_page to edit an existing page instead of creating a new one, and create_module_item's page_url parameter (with type Page) to place this page inside a module. Requires permission to manage wiki content in the course.

body.description: HTML body content of the page

name: create_page
title: Create Page
